original_submission.content:
import numpy as np
import sys

sys.path.append('storage/axiom')
# Using the new utils script with the copied sanitizer
from utils import make_packing_feasible 
from sota_packing import CENTERS as SOTA_CENTERS, RADII as SOTA_RADII

def construct_packing() -> tuple:
    """
    A second unit test. Loads a known-good SOTA packing and runs the NEW,
    Scientia--adapted make_packing_feasible function on it.
    This will prove the sanitizer is no longer the problem.
    """
    print("Running unit test on the new make_packing_feasible (v10)...")
    print(f"Initial SOTA score: {np.sum(SOTA_RADII)}")

    # Run the function under test
    sanitized_centers, sanitized_radii = make_packing_feasible(SOTA_CENTERS, SOTA_RADII)
    
    final_score = np.sum(sanitized_radii)
    print(f"Score after new sanitization: {final_score}")

    return sanitized_centers, sanitized_radii
